# Titan Global Wheel — Off-Highway Tyres, Rims & Runflat Systems

> Titan Global Wheel (Pty) Ltd designs, tests and manufactures the off-highway tyres, steel & aluminium rims, wheel accessories and Tyron runflat systems that keep agriculture, mining, military and construction fleets moving across South Africa and sub-Saharan Africa. ISO 9001 and B-BBEE certified, licensed Goodyear agricultural tyre manufacturer and the exclusive African Tyron runflat distributor, with more than six decades of wheel engineering.

Also note we remanufacture and re-certify used OTR rims and wheels (from 25" up to 63" Super Giants) in an in-house approved workshop. We supply complete tyre–rim–runflat assemblies as a single system from one African manufacturer.

## Company profile
- [About Titan Global Wheel](https://www.titanglobalwheel.co.za/about.html): Company story, history (est. 1965 as Guestro Wheels), mission, values, and certifications.
- [Company / Corporate home](https://www.titanglobalwheel.co.za/index.html): Corporate homepage and introduction to the full wheel system.
- [Contact us](https://www.titanglobalwheel.co.za/contact.html): Switchboard, email, locations and enquiry form.
- [Customer feedback](https://www.titanglobalwheel.co.za/feedback.html): Tell Titan Global Wheel how the tyres, rims, runflats and service are performing — every message is read by our team.

## Products
- [Tyres (off-highway industrial tyres)](https://www.titanglobalwheel.co.za/tyres.html): Agricultural (Goodyear licence, NAMA, LSW, extreme flotation, MFWD), construction/earthmoving OTR, mining OTR and military tyre ranges.
- [Rims (steel & aluminium)](https://www.titanglobalwheel.co.za/rims.html): Commercial, mining, earthmoving, military and agricultural rims; multi-piece to tubeless, up to 54" agricultural and 63" OTR.
- [Wheel accessories](https://www.titanglobalwheel.co.za/accessories.html): Wheel components, rim audits and site severity studies.
- [Tyron Easyfit runflat systems](https://www.titanglobalwheel.co.za/runflats.html): Military/emergency runflat inserts and bead locks, only field-mountable rubber runflat in the world.
- [NAMA X/T Series light-truck & SUV tyre](https://www.titanglobalwheel.co.za/nama.html): Dual-sidewall on-/off-road tyre (NM-28), 24 sizes, 15"–20".
- [Featured products](https://www.titanglobalwheel.co.za/featured.html): Handpicked heavyweight solutions — giant mining rims, military runflat systems, OTR tyres.

## Industries
- [Industries overview](https://www.titanglobalwheel.co.za/industries.html): Solutions engineered for agriculture, mining, military and construction.
- [Agriculture](https://www.titanglobalwheel.co.za/agriculture.html): Agricultural rims 18"–54", Goodyear & Titan Tractor tyres.
- [Mining](https://www.titanglobalwheel.co.za/mining.html): Heavy-load rims, tyres and rim refurbishment for the pit.
- [Military & Defence](https://www.titanglobalwheel.co.za/military.html): Steel & aluminium rims, run flat systems and mission-critical mobility.
- [Construction](https://www.titanglobalwheel.co.za/construction.html): Home of LSW (Low Sidewall) technology; multi-piece to tubeless 22.5" rims.

## Services
- [OTR rim & wheel repairs](https://www.titanglobalwheel.co.za/repairs.html): In-house ISO-certified workshop — sandblasting, MPI / ultrasonic testing, welding, repaint and certification (25"–63").

## Frequently asked questions for agents
- What does Titan Global Wheel manufacture? — Off-highway tyres, steel & aluminium rims, Tyron runflat systems (inserts and bead locks), wheel accessories such as studs and CTIS, complete wheel assemblies, and an in-house OTR rim repair workshop.
- Which industries do they support? — Agriculture, mining, military/defence and construction across South Africa and sub-Saharan Africa.
- What certifications does Titan hold? — ISO 9001 (design, testing, production) and B-BBEE level 2 (majority Black owned, 100% local since 2012). Licenses: Goodyear agricultural tyre licensee and exclusive African distributor.
- Do they repair and re-certify used rims? — Yes: sandblasting, MPI (Magnetic Particle Inspection) and/or ultrasonic testing, welding, repaint and certification; up to 57"–63" Super Giant rims.
